hypothesis: Against identical inputs, trained-model capacity, optimizer steps and heldout OOD recall tests, does exposure to randomly permuted support/query episodes with controlled 16/32/64-token blank/decoy interference improve the original static-Mamba hybrid's heldout 128-token distractor retrieval relative to a fixed-16-token Mamba arm that saw the same key/value information? Does a near-active-parameter-matched 3-attention replacement perform differently on this matched mixed exposure?

arms.training_gap: structured task-positive reference only, no temporal input
always no gap, same permuted binding episodes as mixed arms
deterministic schedule base16, blank32, decoy32, blank64, decoy64
same exact mixed delays/decoys as mamba_mixed

training.random_pair_and_query_permutation: verified S9 per-example nonidentity permutation on same key/value episode, seed*10000000+step*17
training.decoy_generator: heldout/build tokens_with_delay S13; fixed K/V data, independent generated decoys per training episode seed + 451231

heldout.positive_oracle: exact target by true 4 support pairs (0 MSE)
heldout.negative_oracle: cyclic true support rotation error>=1.5 MSE
heldout.reference_conventional_limit: structured four support pairs, NOT same temporal input or matched FLOPs

reporting.primary: MIXED_DELAY_TRAINING_CAUSAL_GAIN only if frozen relative, absolute and three-seed criteria meet; otherwise TRAINING_EXPOSURE_GAIN_NOT_DEMONSTRATED
reporting.secondary: NATIVE_MAMBA_VS_ATTENTION_OOD_EXPLORATORY under same mixed exposure but ~1% active parameter difference and unmatched FLOPs; only if ratio, abs and all seeds pass
reporting.robust_retention: UNSEEN_DELAY128_ROBUSTNESS only if abs and ratio all seeds, corruption control and positive oracles pass
reporting.negative: Always report all negative/null results; do not post-result retune thresholds.
reporting.science_limit: No independent scientific acceptance, multi-task transfer, relationship composition, cold retention across learning episodes, or token-free intelligence demonstrated.

stop: dataset heldout collision or query target leak
all three native initial weights differ
training/heldout episode or step count mismatch
